entries.description: Session 1 start registered (claude-fable-5 orchestrator). Read project-guidance, lessons-learned, spec, workflow doc. Keys verified; prereq 005 change-log confirmed.

Reviewed Pipeline (NavigationGraph, UsageIdentification, Cleanup, Migration, Classification skim) + Core/Enrichment enrichers; proven probes: golden qxt* crosstab code=16 mislabeled MakeTable and classified PossiblyUnused; NavigationGraphBuilder/UnresolvedItemAggregator/EnrichmentPipelineRunner zero production call sites; BOM on 4 usage/cleanup outputs; Q6 dead code; label provenance casing drift
